name: offer-block
title: Offer block
description: The offer as the posts and the Creator plan ad close: a centered Funnel Display headline, the terms in capitals with concrete numbers and one White button, with the light flowing in around them or from the top over a plan card.
use_for: The last section of a page, or the pricing page's top: one offer, one action.
never: The light boxed in behind the headline
source: Figma page 8: Post, Offer (Stop screenshotting at midnight. at 404; $10 for your first month, then $20/month in capitals at 580; Button, Start Creator for 50% off 320x64 at 626); Ad, Creator plan offer (Light field 1080x612 over the headline and the plan card)

examples.name: Post
examples.label: As the offer post
examples.content:
<!-- The offer post: the headline, the terms in capitals and one White button. -->
<spyglass-offer-block headline="Stop screenshotting at midnight." note="$10 for your first month, then $20/month" cta='{"label":"Start Creator for 50% off","href":"#pricing"}'></spyglass-offer-block>

examples.name: Plan
examples.label: Over the plan card
examples.content:
<!-- The Creator plan ad: the light field over the headline and the plan card. -->
<spyglass-offer-block headline="Stop screenshotting at midnight." light="field" seed="0">
  <spyglass-plan-card class="w-150 max-w-full text-left" heading="Creator" price="$10 for your first month, then $20/month" features='["AI-powered research across brands, creators, ads, and campaigns","Unlimited board swipe files, alerts, and tracked brands","Unlimited team seats"]' cta="Start Creator for 50% off"></spyglass-plan-card>
</spyglass-offer-block>
